items/ItemPower.comment: items.gear.power: fills one used-item entry of an impact that starts with ImpactItemConfig (impact_initialize's 0x197599, two calls: weapon and ammunition): (entry*, const ItemInstanceInfo*, ctx, job*) copies the 20-byte ItemInstanceInfo (pide at +0x0c), looks the item up (+0x18), reads its level (+0x20) and computes its power (0x91e9d0) into the entry (+0x24, captured). The impact's damage is then (weapon power + ammunition power) x distribution (0x192250, docs/re/abilities.md). kiln.items detours it and multiplies the power of an item entity with a scale (kiln_items.h power and armour scales). Server 26430253 0x1933b0, client 26430625 0x3f2110 (docs/re/items.md section 20)

items/EquipItem.comment: the game's equip (EMF's equipItem): (Result12* out, tx, u64 inventorySlotId, u8 keen::EquipmentSlot) moves the stack in that slot into the equipment slot of the program's current entity (the player: ProgramContext +8, not the transaction's operator), inside the transaction; an EquipmentSlot of 24 or more lets the item pick its own slot. Error 0 ok, 0x11 refused (the item's EquipmentSlotType is not the slot's, or a move failed), 0x15 no item there, 0x1f the current entity has no SlotSelection or InventorySetup, or no free slot. Server 26430253 0x1b4e70, client 26430625 0x4152d0 (docs/re/items.md section 16)

items/UnequipItem.comment: the game's unequip: (Result12* out, tx, u64 inventorySlotId, u8 keen::EquipmentSlot) moves what the current entity's equipment slot holds into a free Generic slot of its inventory (an EquipmentSlot of 24 or more: the equipment slot that holds inventorySlotId). Error codes as items/EquipItem. Server 26430253 0x1b9b80, client 26430625 0x419740
